comparison.objective: These rows pursue assembly, insertion, fastening, extraction, measurement, cutting, coating, care, food handling, packaging, transport, inspection, or other outcomes rather than size-selective separation of a mixed loose-body load through a manual screen.
comparison.physical_skill: None requires the candidate's combined ability of bimanually grasping and load-sharing a perforated screen, lifting and orientation-controlling it, using restrained agitation to make smaller ceramic bodies traverse real apertures while larger ring-shaped workpieces remain inside, then aligning the loaded screen back onto two supports and releasing it.
comparison.success_condition: Their goals terminate in their respective fitted, moved, measured, processed, or made-safe states, not in a measured recovery fraction for pass-through media together with complete retained-workpiece preservation, no spill or invalid passage, support reseating, bilateral release clearance, and a continuously revalidated dwell.
comparison.reason: After reading every row's title, instruction, category, and keywords, these rows are unrelated on all three novelty axes; occasional shared primitives such as bimanual carrying, tilting, loose-object handling, containment, or reseating do not test the candidate's physical aperture-based selective separation outcome.
